consequence.statement: The metrics are exposed under new names, so anything querying the old names will no longer match them.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and queries to the new metric names.

assertion.statement: Crossplane's Prometheus metric name prefixes were renamed: crossplane_composition_controllers_* to engine_controllers_*, crossplane_composition_watches_* to engine_watches_*, and crossplane_composition_run_function_* to function_run_function_*.
